base: Explain what a database index is and why adding one can make writes slower.

Summarize the following text, preserving every concrete number and constraint.

---
Our ingestion pipeline processes roughly 4.2 million events per day across 37 source systems. Until March, each source had its own bespoke parser, which meant a schema change upstream broke ingestion an average of 3 times per month, with a mean time to recovery of 4 hours. We replaced the bespoke parsers with a declarative mapping layer: each source now ships a YAML descriptor, validated against a JSON Schema at deploy time. Breakages dropped to 0.4 per month and MTTR to 25 minutes. The migration took 6 engineer-weeks. The remaining failures are concentrated in 2 legacy SOAP sources that cannot emit a stable schema; we plan to sunset them in Q4. Cost went up 11% because validation runs on every event rather than every batch.
---
Explain idempotency to a product manager with no distributed systems background, in a way that helps them reason about what to promise customers. No bullet points, no headings.
